claims.text: Traefik is a proxy (its docs call it an application proxy) whose project publishes the official Helm chart traefik in its own chart repository, the repoURL in apps/traefik.yaml.
claims.source_hint: Traefik docs: Setup > Kubernetes (official Helm chart); deploy/gitops/config-repo/apps/traefik.yaml lines 13-14

claims.text: A chart repository is an HTTP server that holds an index.yaml and packaged charts; a chart is downloaded from it by name and version.
claims.source_hint: helm.sh docs: Topics > The Chart Repository Guide

claims.text: Chart.yaml's version field is the chart's own version; appVersion is the version of the app the chart contains and is not related to version.
claims.source_hint: helm.sh docs: Topics > Charts > The Chart.yaml File (Charts and Versioning; The appVersion field)

claims.text: Chart traefik 41.6.1 has appVersion v3.7.13 and renders image docker.io/traefik:v3.7.13; chart 41.4.0 renders docker.io/traefik:v3.7.12.
claims.source_hint: helm show chart traefik --repo <repoURL> --version 41.6.1; outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/traefik-install.txt lines 38-42

claims.text: In an Argo CD Application whose source is a Helm chart, repoURL is the chart repository, chart the chart name and targetRevision the chart version to use.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Helm (Declarative: source.chart, targetRevision); Declarative Setup > Helm Chart Repositories

claims.text: spec.source.helm.valuesObject passes values to the chart as a YAML object inside the Application, the way a values file would.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Helm > Values (valuesObject)

claims.text: helm show values <chart> --version <v> (here with --repo) prints the chart's values.yaml for that version; <repo-name>/<chart>, as in traefik/traefik, names the same chart from a repository added locally with helm repo add.
claims.source_hint: helm.sh docs: Helm Commands > helm show values (flags --version, --repo); helm repo add; Quickstart (repo/chart naming)

claims.text: Argo CD uses Helm only to inflate (render) charts with helm template; the application's lifecycle is handled by Argo CD, not Helm, and the result is synced like other manifests.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Helm (opening note: 'Helm is only used to inflate charts with helm template')

claims.text: Argo CD renders with helm template, so no Helm release exists for the chart: Helm stores release records as Secrets in the release's namespace only when Helm itself installs the chart; helm list --all-namespaces prints only its header at stage-3.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Helm; helm.sh docs: Topics > Advanced (release storage as Secrets); outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/traefik-install.txt lines 32-34

claims.text: No Application in deploy/gitops/config-repo syncs the apps/ folder; apps/traefik.yaml is applied with kubectl (traefik-install.sh line 29), so after a commit changing or reverting it, the file must be applied again.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang stage-3: grep 'path:' deploy/gitops/config-repo/apps/*.yaml (envs/staging, platform/edge, platform/policies only); scripts/k8s/traefik-install.sh lines 20-31

claims.text: apps/traefik.yaml: valuesObject sets 5 values under providers, gateway, service, ports; gateway.enabled: false stops the chart creating its own Gateway; NodePort 30080/30443 are ports the staging node publishes; automated selfHeal+prune at lines 41-44, then syncOptions.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang deploy/gitops/config-repo/apps/traefik.yaml lines 19-49 at stage-3 (comments lines 25, 28-29)

claims.text: Keys not set in the supplied values keep the defaults from the chart's values.yaml; supplied values override only the keys they set.
claims.source_hint: helm.sh docs: Chart Template Guide > Values Files (precedence: chart values.yaml, then user-supplied)

claims.text: At chart 41.6.1, traefik-install.sh counts 56 top-level keys and 1697 lines in helm show values.
claims.source_hint: outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/traefik-install.txt line 36; traefik-install.sh line 49

claims.text: helm template --repo <url> --version <v> renders a chart fetched from the repository locally, faking in-cluster lookups, and creates no release; kubectl create --dry-run=client prints the object without sending it, and -o jsonpath prints the selected field.
claims.source_hint: helm.sh docs: Helm Commands > helm template; kubernetes.io kubectl reference: kubectl create (--dry-run=client), JSONPath support

claims.text: Diffing renders of 41.4.0 and 41.6.1 with the same values: helm.sh/chart label differs in 8 places and the image line in 1 (v3.7.12 to v3.7.13); diff marks old-file lines with < and new-file lines with >; uniq -c counts repeats.
claims.source_hint: outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/traefik-install.txt lines 38-42; GNU diff/uniq manuals

claims.text: providers.kubernetesGateway.enabled: true turns on Traefik's Gateway API provider, in addition to the Ingress provider it runs by default.
claims.source_hint: Traefik docs: Setup > Kubernetes (Enable Gateway API Provider); apps/traefik.yaml lines 21-24

claims.text: With selfHeal on, Argo CD reverts changes made by hand to objects it syncs, including those rendered from a chart.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Automated Sync Policy > Automatic Self-Healing; devops.l3.self-heal

claims.text: Values set by the user override the chart's defaults, so a full copy of values.yaml keeps its old value for any default a newer chart version changes.
claims.source_hint: helm.sh docs: Chart Template Guide > Values Files (user-supplied values override chart defaults)

claims.text: Keeping only the changed keys in the Application is preferable when reviewers need to see what Đơn Hàng changes; a full copy has the advantage of showing every value in one place, which helm show values at the pinned version also gives.
claims.source_hint: authoring judgement; Argo CD docs: User Guide > Helm (values in Application)

claims.text: Argo CD acts on Application objects stored in the API server (namespace argocd); a change to apps/traefik.yaml in Git takes effect only after the file is applied again, since no Application syncs apps/.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Operator Manual > Declarative Setup (Applications as Kubernetes resources); traefik-install.sh line 29

claims.text: In traefik-install.sh, chart_repo is set to the chart repository (line 10), the helm function adds --kube-context kind-donhang-staging (line 7), and show prints a command before running it (line 8).
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang scripts/k8s/traefik-install.sh lines 6-10 at stage-3

claims.text: git revert <commit> records a new commit that undoes the changes of that commit; the reverted commit stays in history.
claims.source_hint: git-scm.com docs: git-revert (Description)
